title: 3. Her supplication seeking divine mercy
categoryChain: Her supplications for herself and others for the world and the hereafter
introduction:
Her supplication seeking divine mercy

It is narrated from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) that Fatima lived for sixty days after the passing away of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) and then fell ill, when her illness intensified, she recited the following supplication:

Another supplication

verses.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ فَاَغِثْنِيْ، اَللّٰهُمَّ زَحْزِحْنِيْ عَنِ النَّارِ وَ اَدْخِلْنِيْ الْجَنَّةَ، وَ اَلْحِقْنِيْ بِاَبِيْ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ۔
يَا رَبِّ اِنِّيْ قَدْ سَئِمْتُ الْحَيَاةَ، وَ تَبَرَّمْتُ بِاَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا فَاَلْحِقْنِيْ بِاَبِيْ۔
